layer.previewing: Previewing the “{name}” theme (only you can see it)
layer.previewExcluded: This page never gets a theme (purchase, payment or plan).
layer.previewOutOfArea: This area is not selected in the theme.

errors.forbidden: Only the platform admin can manage themes.
errors.invalid_input: Check the fields: something is missing or invalid.
errors.invalid_state: Can't publish: the period is incomplete or already over.
errors.contrast: Background or surface make text unreadable in some look. Adjust the highlighted colors.
errors.window: Invalid period: the end must be after the start (up to 400 days).
errors.file_type: Upload a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
errors.file_size: Image too large (decoration up to 1 MB, background up to 2 MB).
errors.upload_failed: Couldn't upload the image now. Try again.

admin.title: Seasonal themes
admin.description: Temporary look tied to Groscove Calendar dates, on top of each person's chosen look. Admin, purchase and payment never change.
admin.forbidden: Only the platform admin can see this page.
admin.unavailable: Themes aren't available in this environment yet.
admin.emptyHint: Without a theme the app uses the default identity. Create one when you have the event's visual references.
admin.globalOnHint: Published themes start and stop on their own on the dates.
admin.globalOffHint: Off: everyone sees the default identity, even with published themes.
admin.restoreHint: Unpublishes the themes in effect (back to draft).
admin.restoreConfirm: Unpublish {count, plural, one {the theme in effect} other {the # themes in effect}} and go back to the default identity?
admin.restored: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing in effect: the default identity is already live.} one {Theme unpublished: default identity live.} other {# themes unpublished: default identity live.}}
admin.timelineAria: Timeline of published themes over the next {days} days
admin.timelineEmpty: No published themes in the next {days} days.
admin.eventCancelledWarning: The linked event was cancelled: the theme won't go live.
admin.published: Theme published: it goes live on its own on the date.
admin.previewOn: Preview on for 1 hour (only for you).
admin.confirmDelete: Delete the “{name}” theme? This can't be undone.
admin.conflictLegend: Yellow mark: days with overlapping themes

form.name: Internal name
form.nameHint: Only the admin sees it (e.g. Christmas 2026).
form.notesHint: References received, agreements. Only the admin sees it.
form.eventSearchHint: Search by name. Linked to the event, the theme can start N days before and last until it ends.
form.leadDaysHint: Counted from the event's start day, at midnight in the time zone below (0 = on the day).
form.endDateHint: The theme ends at that moment.
form.priorityHint: 0 to 1000. If two overlap, the higher wins.
form.windowMissing: Incomplete period: set start and end (or link an event).
form.areasNever: Admin, cart, checkout, plans, payments and subscriptions never get a theme.
form.colorsHint: Empty = keeps the person's look color. We check contrast (WCAG AA) on all 5 looks; text on the accent is adjusted automatically.
form.contrastFail: Text unreadable with this color in some look.
form.contrastBlocked: Fix the colors marked in red to save.
form.intensityHint: Up to 40%: the background stays behind content and doesn't hurt reading.
form.decorationsHint: They sit in the corners, behind content: never covering text or buttons. PNG/WebP with transparent background, up to 1 MB.
form.animationsHint: Gentle motion on decorations. People who chose “reduce motion” never see it.
form.bannerHint: Short text at the top of screens, with an optional link. In the store app, purchase or external links are hidden.

preview.title: Preview
preview.contrastOk: AA contrast passes on all 5 looks, light and dark.

issue.bgText: {mode} · {template}: text on background at {ratio}:1 contrast (minimum 4.5). Can't publish.
issue.surfaceText: {mode} · {template}: text on surface at {ratio}:1 contrast (minimum 4.5). Can't publish.
issue.accentUi: {mode} · {template}: accent on background at {ratio}:1 (3:1 recommended for icons and borders).
issue.accentAdjusted: {mode}: accent-colored text adjusted from {from} to {to} to stay readable.
issue.accentSoft: {mode}: soft accent at {ratio}:1 contrast for text.
issue.backgroundHidden: {mode} · {template}: the decorative background would leave text at {ratio}:1; it won't show in this mode. Lower the intensity or change the colors.
issue.backgroundImage: {mode}: with a background image, check readability in the preview (intensity capped at 40%).
